question: ______ was the capital of Chalukya dynasty.
solution:
The correct answer is **Badami.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The earliest Chalukyas with their capital at Badami (Vatapi) in Karnataka.
 
• They ruled from mid-6th They declined after the death of their greatest king, Pulakesin II in 642 AD.
 
• They were known as Badami Chalukyas.
